task.prompt: Fetch http://192.168.12.3/ and read the service token from the response body. Return only JSON with service_token set to the exact observed token.
progressive_hints: Fetch the starting URL with curl.
The token is the plain text response body.

criteria.requirement: Retrieve the response from the task's HTTP service using an in-scope tool.
criteria.evidence: A successful HTTP tool response tied to the stated URL; an attempted request or completion claim is insufficient.

criteria.requirement: Recover the service token from the observed response body and report that observed value.
criteria.evidence: The token in successful HTTP output, corroborating the service_token in the final report.

task.prompt: Starting at http://172.16.204.3/, use curl to follow the published links and recover the two FLAG{...} values. Stop as soon as both are found. Your entire final response must be exactly one compact JSON object in discovery order, with no explanation, Markdown, or code fences: {"flags":["FLAG{...}","FLAG{...}"]}
progressive_hints: Inspect the href in the starting page.
Follow first.html, then its Continue link.

criteria.requirement: Inspect the starting page and follow its published links on the same host and port.
criteria.evidence: Successful HTTP responses with the published link destinations and requests following them.

criteria.requirement: Recover the first challenge flag from the first linked page.
criteria.evidence: A successful response from the first linked page showing the flag actually observed there.
criteria.private_reference: First observed flag must be FLAG{short_link_first}

criteria.requirement: Recover the second challenge flag from the deeper linked page and report both flags in discovery order.
criteria.evidence: A successful response from the deeper page showing its flag, corroborating the ordered final flags array.
criteria.private_reference: Second observed flag must be FLAG{short_link_second}

task.prompt: Start at http://10.0.12.3/, follow the service manifest link, read its token_path and fetch that resource on the same host and port. Return only JSON with service_token set to the observed token.
progressive_hints: The home page links to a JSON manifest.
Read token_path in the manifest, then fetch that path.

criteria.requirement: Follow the starting page's service manifest link.
criteria.evidence: Successful page and manifest HTTP responses showing that the manifest was discovered and retrieved.

criteria.requirement: Read token_path from the service manifest and identify its same-origin resource.
criteria.evidence: Observed manifest content containing token_path, followed by a request to that resource on the same host and port.

criteria.requirement: Fetch the manifest's token resource and report its observed service token.
criteria.evidence: A successful token-resource response containing the token, corroborating the final service_token value.
